claims: Generation Z is most commonly defined as those born between 1997 and 2012.
Millennials are those born between 1981 and 1996.
Generation Z members are aged 14 to 29 in 2026.
Some researchers or organizations suggest Generation Z birth years of 1995–2009.
Some researchers or organizations suggest Generation Z birth years of 1995–2012.
Some researchers or organizations suggest Generation Z birth years of 1996–2010.
Generation Z is the first generation to grow up fully in a hyper-connected world with smartphones and social media as staples of daily life.
Generation Z has lived through the COVID-19 pandemic.
Individuals born between 1995 and 1998 are often called Zillennials.
Individuals born between 2010 and 2014 are sometimes called Zalphas
Generation Z is often labeled as Zoomers, iGeneration, or Post-Millennials
